description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing client data, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting clients, with API calls and dispatching actions.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Fetches a client by ID and dispatches corresponding Redux actions, with loading state management.

methods.name: getClientsByUser
methods.description: Fetches clients associated with a user based on a search query, managing loading state.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client via API and dispatches an action, also triggers a success snackbar.

methods.name: updateClient
methods.description: Updates an existing client by ID via API, dispatches update action, and shows success message.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes a client by ID via API, dispatches delete action, and shows success message.
